stories.title: Provider Detail Response Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define canonical response schema for provider details aligned to NPI Registry fields (specialty, license, status, address, phone, enumeration date) using Pydantic validation patterns for consistency across services.

stories.title: NPI Registry Lookup Core Logic
stories.description: Implement service logic to call CMS NPI Registry API, handle response parsing, normalize provider attributes, and ensure resilience to missing or partial data.

stories.title: Provider Detail Method in EvaluateCare Facade
stories.description: Add dedicated provider detail retrieval method in EvaluateCare facade to orchestrate service calls and standardize output for downstream tool usage.

stories.title: Tool Router Exposure for Provider Detail Lookup
stories.description: Expose provider detail lookup via tool router with validated inputs (NPI) and structured output, ensuring compatibility with Anthropic tool-use flow and input validation.

stories.title: Provider Detail Lookup Test Suite
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests validating NPI lookup accuracy, schema adherence, facade orchestration, tool routing, and error handling for invalid or incomplete provider data.
